name: SPCA of Solano County
releaseWindow: Phone intake opens weekdays 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM

notes: Low-cost community spay/neuter; feral slots must be pre-arranged directly by phone.

releaseWindow: Vouchers issued first-come at shelter front counter

releaseWindow: Slots release every Monday at 10:00 AM for the upcoming clinic cycle

name: Sacramento SPCA Spay & Neuter Clinic
releaseWindow: 10 appointment spots will open each evening at 6:00 PM for the next day’s clinic. We ask if you are unable to trap a cat by 10pm, please cancel your appointment so that other trappers who were successful can use the appointment. Appointments must be made by 6:30 AM on the day of your visit.

countyFreeProgram.details: FREE TNR for residents within City of Sacramento & unincorporated County boundaries (funded via municipal animal care contracts).$65 fee if trapped outside Sacramento County

notes: Dedicated Sunday feral cat clinic days plus regular weekday community cat drop-offs by appointment. Accepts ferals from other counties at $65 fee.

countyFreeProgram.details: Accepts Sacramento County Animal Care vouchers for $0 copay community cat sterilizations.

notes: High-volume surgical center adjacent to Sacramento County Animal Care.

name: Animal Fix Clinic

notes: Dedicated community cat surgery center (formerly Fix Our Ferals). Online booking required.

releaseWindow: Calendar opens 30 days in advance on a rolling daily basis
